scope: Bounded automated token/key/bearer scan plus source-selected evidence review; gzip and ZIP payloads decoded. Not an exhaustive secret detector.
retainedProvenance: Raw report/receipt local filesystem paths and public GitHub identities retained intentionally; no path-normalization transformation. GitHub-masked authorization placeholders are not credential values.
excludedContent: No user documents, databases, browser profiles, cookie stores or environment dumps were collected.

supplementalInspection.reason: Local guard disposition and Storybook applicability wording only; no new credentials/content inputs.
